ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited (ABREL) has completed the slump sale of its 'Century Pulp and Paper' undertaking to ITC Limited, effective August 1, 2026. This transaction represents a material divestment, significantly altering ABREL's operational profile, revenue streams, and asset base as it exits a core industrial business. As a routine completion notice for a previously approved strategic decision, this document does not immediately present any red flags.
